params.prompt: A wide flat background view as seen through a window on a bright spring morning: the old Seoul fortress wall of large grey granite blocks running along a green hill with pine trees and a few blossoming trees, a low traditional pavilion roof far away on the ridge, pale cream sky. Painted as a flat anime background, no frame, no people. Flat-colored anime background painting style for a cel-shaded game: flat matte colors, thin warm-black ink lines, subtle paper grain, muted low-saturation palette. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks.
